key_insight: EvoArena shows that LLM agents need more than benchmark performance on static tasks—they must also adapt their memory and behavior as environments change over time. The paper introduces a dynamic evaluation framework to measure how robust agents are under progressive updates.
problem_solved: Most LLM evaluations assume fixed conditions, but real-world deployment involves changing tools, software, and terminal environments. This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for testing whether agents can stay effective as their context evolves.
method: Introduces EvoArena, a benchmark suite designed around sequences of progressive environment updates.
Evaluates LLM agents across dynamic settings such as terminal, software, and other changing task environments.
Tracks how agent memory, knowledge alignment, and behavior evolve in response to updates.
impact: This benchmark helps researchers and practitioners understand whether an LLM agent remains reliable after environment changes, not just at initial deployment. It is useful for building more robust agents that can operate in realistic, long-lived settings.
visual_elements: Timeline graphic showing progressive environment updates over time
Before/after comparison of agent performance in static vs dynamic settings
System diagram illustrating memory, knowledge, and behavior adaptation
Icons for terminal, software, and changing environment conditions
paper_title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
paper_authors: Jundong Xu, Qingchuan Li, Jiaying Wu, Yihuai Lan, Shuyue Stella Li
